1: // Simple endless runner game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: // Ship moves upward on click/tap, gravity pulls down, asteroids appear randomly.
3: (function(){
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if(!canvas){ console.error('Canvas #game not found'); return; }
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Game objects
11:   const ship = { x: 80, y: H/2, w: 30, h: 20, vy: 0 };
12:   const asteroids = [];
13:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
14:   const stars = [];
15:   for(let i=0;i<STAR_COUNT;i++){
16:     stars.push({x: Math.random()*W, y: Math.random()*H, r: Math.random()*2});
17:   }
18: 
19:   let lastTime = 0;
20:   let gameOver = false;
21: 
22:   // Input – click/tap adds upward thrust
23:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown',()=> ship.vy=-0.6);
24:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart',()=> ship.vy=-0.6);
25: 
26:   function spawnAsteroid(){
27:     const size = 20+Math.random()*30;
28:     asteroids.push({x:W+size, y:Math.random()*(H-size), w:size, h:size, vx:-2-Math.random()*2});
29:   }
30: 
31:   function update(dt){
32:     if(gameOver) return;
33:     // gravity
34:     ship.vy += 0.0015*dt; // gentle pull down
35:     ship.y += ship.vy*dt*0.06; // scale speed
36:     // bounds check (bottom ends game)
37:     if(ship.y > H - ship.h){ gameOver = true; }
38:     // move asteroids
39:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
40:       const a = asteroids[i];
41:       a.x += a.vx*dt*0.06;
42:       if(a.x + a.w < 0) asteroids.splice(i,1);
43:     }
44:     // spawn periodically
45:     if(Math.random()<0.02) spawnAsteroid();
46:     // collision detection
47:     for(const a of asteroids){
48:       if(ship.x < a.x + a.w && ship.x + ship.w > a.x &&
49:          ship.y < a.y + a.h && ship.y + ship.h > a.y){
50:         gameOver = true; break;
51:       }
52:     }
53:   }
54: 
55:   function draw(){
56:     // clear
57:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
58:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
59:     // stars
60:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
61:     for(const s of stars){
62:       ctx.beginPath();
63:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r,0,Math.PI*2);
64:       ctx.fill();
65:     }
66:     // ship (triangle)
67:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
68:     ctx.beginPath();
69:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
70:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
71:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h/2);
72:     ctx.closePath();
73:     ctx.fill();
74:     // asteroids (circles)
75:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
76:     for(const a of asteroids){
77:       ctx.beginPath();
78:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/2,0,Math.PI*2);
79:       ctx.fill();
80:     }
81:     // game over overlay
82:     if(gameOver){
83:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
84:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
85:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
86:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
87:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
88:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W/2, H/2);
89:     }
90:   }
91: 
92:   function loop(timestamp){
93:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
94:     lastTime = timestamp;
95:     if(!gameOver) update(dt);
96:     draw();
97:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
98:   }
99:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
100: })();
